    THE UNION OF CONCERNED SCIENTISTS’ PETITION TO INTERVENE AND


                        REQ QUEST FOR INCLUSION ON SERVICE LIST

The Union of Concerned Scientists (“UCS”) respectfully requests that the Louisiana Public

Service Commission (“LPSC”) grant UCS the right to intervene in the above captioned docket.




                                                   1.


Notice of this proceeding was published in the LPSC’s Official Bulletin Number 1372, dated

March 27, 2026. Interventions were due within 15 days of the date of the LPSC’s Official

Bulletin. This intervention is therefore timely.




                                                   2.


Rule 10 of the LPSC Rules of Practice and Procedures provides that any party actually in interest

may appear in any proceeding before the LPSC.


                                                   3.


UCS is a leading science-based advocacy nonproﬁt with more than half a million supporters

nationwide, including more than 1,000 in Louisiana. We put rigorous, independent science into

action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future.


                                                   4.


UCS intends to participate in this proceeding on behalf of our Louisiana supporters to help

ensure that the   signiﬁcant investments contemplated in this docket do not place undue economic,
 environmental, or other burdens on ratepayers in the state.




                                                   5.


UCS possesses standing to intervene in the aforementioned matter, and respectfully seeks full

intervenor status in order to fully participate in this docket. UCS requests that it be placed on the

service list of this proceeding and be served with all pleadings, notices, orders, and other ﬁlings.

This intervention will not prejudice delay the proceedings with respect to the examination of the

issues presented by this proceeding.
